story:
The Story

NANA in giant mustard capitals over WON'T TELL MOM: this nana hoodie is for the grandma who hands out the cookies, the extra presents and the second helping, worn at the grandkids' house, the holidays and the school recital.

A vintage storybook grandma with silver curls and glasses sits in a wooden rocking chair with a cookie jar on one knee, a little stack of wrapped presents beside her and a ball of yarn on the floor, under WON'T TELL MOM. in rose pink capitals with a dark plum outline. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.
faq: Is this nana hoodie a good gift for grandma?

Yes. The Won't Tell Mom hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a funny gift for a nana who sneaks the grandkids cookies and keeps it quiet, printed to order on a soft 8 oz fleece pullover. Order by about December 8 and it arrives in time for Christmas.

It is a classic unisex pullover in sizes S to 3XL, so it runs roomy and layers over a blouse. Order your usual size for a relaxed fit or one size down for a closer one. Graphic Tees Co. also gives one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery.

The hoodie is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a double-lined hood, a front pouch pocket and ribbed cuffs. It is warm enough for a cool evening porch or the school recital line, and soft enough to wear indoors all day.

Turn the hoodie inside out, wash in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and never iron directly over the print. Graphic Tees Co. prints each hoodie when you order it, and a misprinted or damaged one is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
Why are there two colors, Sand and Navy?

Sand is the soft neutral for a grandma who likes it understated, and Navy makes the mustard NANA and rose pink lettering pop. Both show the same art, each with a dark plum outline, and every size ships free to the US on orders of $45 or more from Graphic Tees Co.
